name: cl-orchestration
description: Coordinates the issues of several projects from one session: worker jobs, reviews and merge checks, and a handoff file that a cleared or compacted coordinator resumes from.

rotateAtTokens.title: Clear an idle coordinator above this many context tokens
rotateAtTokens.description: 200000 by default; 0 turns it off while rotateAtPercent is also 0. Applies only to a session in an Orca terminal whose project folder (where Claude Code started) holds the handoff file of /cl-orchestration:orchestrating-projects (.cedarloom/runs/handoff.md) and whose file names that terminal (a Terminal: line). When such a coordinator ends a turn with no background task running and its context is above this size, the plugin clears it with /clear and submits a prompt that resumes it from the file; after a clear or compaction it hands the file back. At most one clear every 10 minutes. Without the file nothing happens.

rotateAtPercent.title: Clear an idle coordinator above this percent of the context window
rotateAtPercent.description: 0 (default) is off and rotateAtTokens applies. Above 0, an idle coordinator that keeps the handoff file of /cl-orchestration:orchestrating-projects is cleared with /clear and resumed from the file once its context fills this percent of the model's context window, in place of rotateAtTokens.

rotateAfterTasks.title: Clear an idle coordinator after this many settled Orca tasks
rotateAfterTasks.description: 0 (default) is off. Above 0, an idle coordinator that keeps the handoff file of /cl-orchestration:orchestrating-projects is also cleared with /clear and resumed from the file once this many tasks of its Orca run have completed or failed since its last clear, whatever its context size. The plugin then runs orca orchestration task-list --json at each idle stop. The same 10-minute gap applies.
